! Lore
| Representative of armored mining/demolition droids. Converted for military duty. Sets and diffuses mines and explosives. LIN-V8K was refurbished by Jawas. || — || {{Errata hl|Armored military droid which specializes in laying explosive mines. Originally intended to set charges inside ore and spice mines, but has also been converted for military use.}}
